svg.aria-label: Three QuestDB Enterprise instances, a primary and two replicas, drawn as benches side by side, each with its own local disk, and one object store as a deck behind them all. Each partition is a pallet that moves along its bench as it ages, on a log scale. At the TO REMOTE mark only replica 2, the cold storage manager, lifts the partition, as Parquet, onto the deck while every bench keeps its local copy, still native. At TO PARQUET each instance converts its own copy. At DROP LOCAL each instance drops its local data and keeps only its metadata, which reads from the one Parquet partition on the deck. On the same deck, small WAL segments flow continuously from the primary to the replicas.
svg.text: OBJECT STORE · ONE FOR THE WHOLE CLUSTER

g.text: Parquet partition to the object store
uploaded once, by the cold storage manager
